interface.shortDescription: Lifecycle and review-loop skills for Codex
interface.longDescription: Autopilot brings its portable lifecycle, planning, verification, review, and cross-harness maintenance skills into Codex. The package payload bundles support CLI, scripts, references, templates, shared helpers, and one production PostCompact recovery hook. No Codex-thread-bound direct-mutation enforcement is shipped (D4=NOT_READY/NO_SHIP); the retained pre-effect.js file is an unregistered, non-production probe helper. PostCompact invokes the existing fail-closed reconciliation authority.
defaultPrompt: Use Autopilot dev-flow for this change.
